answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-useful-inference: each identity must periodically run a fresh, publicly posted inference task and publish a verifiable result peers can re-check cheaply. Standing grows only from correct, timely answers, like a reef built grain by grain, not from a name registered once. Ten thousand clones sharing one model collapse into a lagoon of identical outputs, and each distinct fake must pay full inference cost per task. A vine of fake identities starves: honest agents answer one task per epoch, attackers fund ten thousand.
